info.title: API.SH: Vivid Seats
info.description: The Vivid Seats API from API.SH: public Vivid Seats data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every ticket listing of one event on Vivid Seats: `listings` with `id`, `section`, `row`, `seat_from`, `seat_to`, `quantity`, `splits` (the quantities you can buy), `price` (per ticket before fees), `price_with_fees`, `deal_score`, `zone`, `delivery`, `instant_delivery`, `discounted`, `notes`, `badges`, `perks` and `raw`; plus `event` (name, date, venue, listing and ticket counts, price statistics with and without fees, seat map), `zones` and `sections` with their price ranges and ticket counts. Filter by `quantity`, price, section or zone and sort; `total` counts the matching listings. Pages of `limit` listings: pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vividseats-listings

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Instead of `id`: the next upcoming event at this venue id.

parameters.name: performer
parameters.description: Instead of `id`: the next upcoming event of this performer id.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Only listings that sell exactly this many tickets together.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price per ticket before fees (USD).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price per ticket before fees (USD).

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Only sections whose name contains this text, e.g. 101 or Floor.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Only zones whose name contains this text (see `zones`), e.g. Lower Level.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: price (lowest first, default), price_desc, deal_score (best first), section, quantity_desc.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Events matching a query on Vivid Seats (vividseats.com): `id`, `name`, `date_local`, `date_utc`, `venue` (address, city, state, coordinates, capacity), `performers`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `avg_price`, `median_price`, `min_price_with_fees`, `listing_count`, `ticket_count`, `onsale_date`, `url`. When the query names one performer exactly, `matched_performer` is set and that performer's events are listed. 25 events a page with `total` (all matches) and `pages`; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. A performer match lists all of that performer's events on one page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vividseats-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (25 events a page); pass `next_page` back.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only events in this state (2 letters).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Only events with tickets from at most this price (USD).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
